senses.gloss: ch. same (corresp. to b. h. תָּעָה) to wander, be lost; to reel.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 21:14">Targ. Y. Gen. XXI, 14</cite> <he>טָעָת</he> (O. ed. Berl. <he>טְעַת</he>, ed. Vien. <he>תָּעַת</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 28:7">Targ. Is. XXVIII, 7</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 19:13">Ib. XIX, 13</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Gittin 68b:2">Gitt. 68ᵇ</cite> <he>רויא דהוה קא טָעֵי באורחא</he> a drunken man that was lost on the road; a. e.

senses.gloss: (corresp. to b. h. זָנָה) to go astray, worship idols, to be licentious &c.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Amos 7:17">Targ. Am. VII, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 34:15">Targ. Ex. XXXIV, 15</cite> <he>ויִטְעוֹן</he> (ed. Amst. O. <he>ויִטְעוּן</he>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 34:16">Ib. 16</cite> <he>ויַטְעַיָן</he> ed. Berl. (ed. Amst. <he>ויִטְעַיַין</he>, Y. I <he>וכד טַעֲיָין</he>, Y. II <he>וִיטַעֲיָן</he>); a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 87">Gen. R. s. 87</cite>, beg. (expl. <he>סררת</he> <cite ref="Proverbs 7:11">Prov. VII, 11</cite>) <cite ref="I00612"><he>טַעֲיָא</he></cite> running about, prostitute, v. <cite ref="I00608"><he>טָעִיתָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:9">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 9</cite> <cite ref="I00595"><he>טְעוּ</he></cite> miscalculated the term of redemption (v.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20">Ex. R. s. 20</cite>).—
<cite ref="Yevamot 121a:13">Yeb. 121ᵃ</cite> <he>מִיטְעָא טְעִינָא</he> I was mistaken; a. e.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 2:17">Targ. Prov. II, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 31:5">Ib. XXXI, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 31:7">7</cite>.
Ib. VI, 20 (ed. Vien. תטעי מנימוסא deviate from).
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 27:18">Targ. Deut. XXVII, 18</cite> <he>יַטְעֵי</he> (not <he>יִטְ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 34:16">Targ. Ex. XXXIV, 16</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 76a:2">B. Mets. 76ᵃ</cite> <he>אַטְעוּ פועלים וכ׳</he> the hired men deceived (the one engaging the others deceived them as to their wages, v. <cite ref="I00601">preced.</cite>); (Var. <he>אִיטְּעוּ וכ׳</he> they were deceived by one of their own).—
<cite ref="Chullin 94b">Ḥull. 94ᵇ</cite> <he>מַטְעוּ נפשייהו</he> they deceive themselves; a. fr.
<cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 19:29">Targ. O. Lev. XIX, 29</cite>.

senses.gloss: (denom. of טַעֲוָא) to deify, worship as deity.
units: <cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 24:17">Targ. II Chr. XXIV, 17</cite> (v.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 8">Ex. R. s. 8</cite>).—[
